name: PERCH held-out persona v1
note: A second fictional person (Priya Nair) with 42 memories and 69 labelled questions. NEVER used to fit floors or the margin: parameters are fitted on the development persona and only scored here. Written by the PERCH authors.

items.title: Who I am
items.body: Priya Nair, data analyst at Kestrel Logistics in Chennai.

items.title: How I want answers
items.body: Tables for comparisons, SQL examples in the PostgreSQL dialect, and keep it concise.

items.title: Spelling and writing voice
items.body: Uses American spelling, following the company style guide. Messages to colleagues are friendly but to the point.

items.title: Standing instructions
items.body: Flag assumptions explicitly. Never state a medicine dose without saying to confirm it with a doctor.

items.title: Languages
items.body: Speaks Malayalam at home, Tamil and English at work.

items.title: Freight ETA model
items.body: Predicts truck arrival times on Kestrel's Chennai-Bengaluru lane with XGBoost on GPS pings. Mean absolute error 38 minutes.

items.title: ETA model: weather features dropped
items.body: Dropped the weather features: the weather API cost more than it was worth, improving MAE by only about a minute.

items.title: Ops dashboard
items.body: Metabase dashboard of delayed shipments for the operations team, refreshed every 15 minutes from Redshift.

items.title: Duplicate GPS pings
items.body: Duplicate GPS pings inflated trip distances. Fixed by de-duplicating on vehicle id within a 30-second window.

items.title: HomeHub
items.body: HomeHub is a Raspberry Pi 4 running Home Assistant at home: lights, the AC through an IR blaster, and a door sensor.

items.title: HomeHub: Zigbee dropouts
items.body: The Zigbee USB dongle kept disconnecting from interference. Fixed with a USB extension cable moving it away from the Pi.

items.title: HomeHub: AC automation
items.body: The AC switches off when the door sensor has seen nobody at home for 20 minutes.

items.title: Airflow migration
items.body: Moving the team's cron jobs to Airflow on MWAA: 12 of 30 DAGs migrated so far.

items.title: SQL conventions at work
items.body: Models are written in dbt, snake_case names, CTEs rather than nested subqueries.

items.title: MBA programme
items.body: Weekend part-time MBA at Coastal School of Management, year 1 of 2, currently in term 3.

items.title: Term 3 courses
items.body: Marketing Management, Corporate Finance and Operations Strategy.

items.title: Corporate Finance
items.body: Taught by Prof. Meena Iyer, case-based. Group assignment: a DCF valuation of a listed company; the group chose TVS Motor.

items.title: Term-end exams
items.body: Term-end exams run from 14 to 16 November 2026.

items.title: Grading
items.body: 40% class participation and cases, 60% end-term exam, relatively graded.

items.title: Operations Strategy project
items.body: Analysing Kestrel's hub-and-spoke network for the Operations Strategy course. Due 2 November 2026.

items.title: Study group
items.body: Five-person study group that meets on Zoom every Wednesday at 9pm.

items.title: Career goal
items.body: Wants to move into product analytics or product management within 18 months. Targets: Zoho, Freshworks, Swiggy.

items.title: Current role
items.body: Data Analyst II at Kestrel since 2023, reporting to Karthik.

items.title: Promotion
items.body: Review cycle in January. Karthik said leading a cross-team project is what is missing; the ETA model should count.

items.title: Salary
items.body: Currently 14 LPA. Expects at least 20 LPA to switch companies.

items.title: PM certificate
items.body: Google Project Management certificate in progress: 3 of 6 courses done.

items.title: Freshworks coffee chat
items.body: Coffee chat with Deepa, a product manager at Freshworks, on 7 October 2026.

items.title: Portfolio case study
items.body: Writing up the ETA model as a case study for a portfolio site on Notion.

items.title: Hypothyroidism
items.body: Hypothyroidism, diagnosed in 2021.

items.title: Thyroid medication
items.body: Levothyroxine 50 mcg every morning on an empty stomach, at least 30 minutes before tea.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.body: Lactose intolerant: milk causes bloating, but curd is fine.

items.title: Migraines
items.body: Migraines about twice a month, triggered by skipped meals and screen glare. Takes naproxen.

items.title: Knee physiotherapy
items.body: Physiotherapy for the left knee after a running injury in August 2026, Tuesdays at 6pm at Kauvery Hospital.

items.title: TSH tests
items.body: TSH checked every six months; the last result was 3.1 and the next test is due in December 2026.

items.title: Eye strain
items.body: Uses computer glasses with a blue filter and follows the 20-20-20 rule for eye strain.

items.title: Husband
items.body: Married to Arjun, a software engineer, since 2024.

items.title: Biscuit the dog
items.body: Biscuit is an indie dog. The vet is Dr. Raman; the next vaccination is due in November 2026.

items.title: Home loan
items.body: Home loan EMI of 38,000 rupees due on the 10th for the flat in Velachery.

items.title: Japan trip
items.body: Trip to Japan with Arjun planned for April 2027. Saving 3 lakh; the visa application goes in during January.

items.title: Mother
items.body: Mother lives in Kochi; they speak every Sunday. Her 60th birthday is on 3 January.

items.title: Food habits
items.body: Eats vegetarian on Tuesdays and Saturdays. Loves Kerala food.

items.title: Violin class
items.body: Carnatic violin class every Saturday at 8am.
